svg.title: A Git workflow that keeps history tidy
svg.desc: Stage selectively, absorb fixes into the commits that own them, review in gitui, and use GitButler to stack work. Delta, difftastic, rerere, and SSH signing support the loop.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
